description: The spec gives the beta skills routes (GET/POST /v1/skills?beta=true, GET /v1/skills/{skill_id}?beta=true) the same `Skill` shape as GA `/v1/skills` — `display_name`, `latest_version_id`, `source: { type }`. The beta routes still answer with the original beta shape: `display_title`, `latest_version` (a version string such as `20260914`) and `source` as a plain string (observed 2026-10-05: GET /v1/skills?beta=true with `anthropic-beta: skills-2025-10-02` returns `{type, id, created_at, updated_at, display_title, source: "anthropic", latest_version}` while GET /v1/skills returns the GA shape). Model `BetaSkill` as the wire does.

value.title: Display Title
value.description: Display title for the skill — a human-readable label, not included in the prompt sent to the model.

value.title: Latest Version
value.description: The latest version identifier for the skill (an epoch-timestamp-style string).

value.title: Source
value.description: Source of the skill: `"custom"` (created by a user) or `"anthropic"` (created by Anthropic).
